UPSSSC is the Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission. It is responsible for conducting exams and selecting candidates for various government jobs in Uttar Pradesh, India.

The UPSSSC Scientific / Lab Assistant Exam is a government job opportunity in India. The exam is conducted by UPSSSC to select candidates for the posts of Scientific Assistant and Lab Assistant.

CareerFlora Expert Insight

The UPSSSC Scientific / Lab Assistant Exam is a great opportunity for those who want to work in the government sector in India. The exam is conducted by UPSSSC and the deadline to apply is 17 August 2026. The eligibility criteria for the exam include UPSSSC PET 2025 Exam Passed and Bachelor Degree in Science. The application fee is 25/- for General/OBC/EWS, 25/- for SC/ST, and 25/- for PH (Divyang).
The best strategy to prepare for the exam is to read the notification carefully, check the eligibility criteria, collect the required documents, fill the online application form, and submit it before the deadline. It is also important to prepare for the exam by studying the syllabus and practicing with sample papers.
